mapper.select: SELECT t2.`name` AS customer_name, t4.nickname AS creator_name, t1.id, t1.order_no, t1.customer_id, t1.mobile, t1.brand_id, t1.order_date, t1.logistic_id, t1.logistic_name, t1.receiver, t1.delivery_address, t1.freight, t1.types, t1.discount_amount, t1.total_amount, t1.amount, t1.rounding, t1.amount_received, t1.delivery_date, t1.pay_status, t1.status, t1.confirm_time, t1.is_expedited, t1.sets, t1.note, t1.current_node_name, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, t1.creator, t1.updater FROM zc_sales_order t1 LEFT JOIN zc_customer t2 ON t1.customer_id = t2.id AND t2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_users t4 ON t1.creator = t4.id AND t4.deleted = 0 WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t1.id = #{id}

SELECT t1.customer_id AS customer_id, t2.`name` AS customer_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(t1.amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(t1.amount_received), 0) AS total_amount_received, COALESCE(SUM(t1.amount - COALESCE(t1.amount_received, 0)), 0) AS unpaid_amount FROM zc_sales_order t1 LEFT JOIN zc_customer t2 ON t1.customer_id = t2.id AND t2.deleted = 0 WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t1.confirm_time IS NOT NULL AND t1.confirm_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.confirmTime[0]} AND #{reqVO.confirmTime[1]} GROUP BY t1.customer_id, t2.`name` ORDER BY total_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM zc_sales_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND delivery_date = #{today} AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status != 'DISCARDED')
